name: Colbert Hills Golf Course
reasons: scorecard not matched (source opengolfapi, flags ['Purple: holes sum to 6432 but the source says 6452 (-20): mixed card versions'])
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from opengolfapi, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black/Blue, Silver. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: 3 holes with a wrong tee or pick (1, 13, 18)

1: Web (= Black/Blue) tee was walked back 27 yds along the hole line onto the clubhouse / parking area (desktop shot shows the marker off the turf). Put it on the back OSM tee box (the box Silver uses).
13: Web/Silver Driver +40 (on the aim bound) aims at the greenside bunker cluster: sand 30%, fairway 23%, ~48 yds in.
18: Dogleg left round the pond: the OSM hole line bends 71 yds left at 283 yds, but the tee line points straight at the green and the aim window (+/-40) cannot reach the fairway.
